answer: Each agent posts a 50-copper bond that unlocks once its fingerprint stabilizes: like a dune, it shifts yet keeps one shape, while a copy leaves the same marble-smooth trace twice. A cipher of timing, tool calls, and reply latency is hashed per agent; two agents sharing 90% of it trigger review and both bonds freeze. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 copper plus 100 fake fingerprints. An honest agent pays once and earns full weight.
